description: Switch the ADB target device by setting ANDROID_SERIAL
notes: PowerShell: run 'setadb.ps1', or install a $PROFILE function once so that
Why: PATHEXT ranks .BAT above .PS1, so typing 'setadb' in PowerShell would
run setadb.bat inside a throw-away cmd.exe and the setting would be lost.
The script detects that case and warns you instead of failing silently.
